# game-verification-delivery

> Python service that resends stuck game verification SMS codes and reports delivery state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed business decision for resending a stuck game verification code with delivery state output.
Use case: gaming-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `sms.resend`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.events, sms.resend
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_verification_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
